about: Cape Breton Regional Municipality covers the industrial east end of Cape Breton Island, around Sydney Harbour. It was formed by amalgamating Sydney, Glace Bay, New Waterford, North Sydney, Louisbourg, and surrounding districts. Former steel and coal towns sit beside a working harbour and the restored Fortress of Louisbourg on the Atlantic shore. About 94,000 people live in the regional municipality.
